layout: node-grid north to south, west to east, inclusive endpoints
context: Ls 21.3° · local time 00:00 at every longitude · 10 m above local surface · climatology average solar scenario
credit: Mars Climate Database © LMD / OU / IAA / ESA / CNES
processing: Parsed numerical fields. Reconstructed unrounded linspace axes from provider code; integer ASCII longitude labels are truncated, not true node coordinates. Transposed longitude-major rows and reversed latitude to north-up. Duplicate date-line columns averaged; discrepancy recorded per field. Display is bilinear interpolation of these nodes.
limitations: Model means, not live weather or extremes.
64 × 48 export sampling is not the native climate-model resolution.
MCD topographic correction does not imply local meteorological accuracy.
No climate field contributes to route cost.
